description: This file defines an SMTP class for handling SMTP protocol communication, including connection, authentication, and message sending, conforming to RFC 821. It is part of a mailer package and provides methods for SMTP operations.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: A class implementing SMTP protocol communication, including connection, authentication, message transmission, and command handling.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SMTP server at specified host and port.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication with username and password.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Sends email message data to the SMTP server after issuing the DATA command.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Requests the server to expand a mailing list or address list.

methods.name: Hello
methods.description: Sends HELO or EHLO command to initialize SMTP communication.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Initiates a mail transaction with the specified sender.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Terminates the SMTP session and closes the connection.
